segments.source: A LONG time ago, when all were men, there was no wind.
Now Bear used to go about with a bag on his back.
The animal people wanted to know what was in the bag.
Many times they asked Bear but he would not tell them.
One day Bear fell asleep with the bag on his back.
Then a man saw him asleep.
The man cut the bag and found the wind in it.
Therefore the wind escaped and has never since been caught.
